2092130.synopsis:
The goddess Urd is in danger, and only Kirito and his friends can save her! The evil frost giants have invaded her homeland of Jotunheim, bringing death and destruction in their wake. The linchpin of it all is the frost giant king's sword-the legendary weapon Excalibur! If Kirito's crew can make it to the end of the dungeon and pull the sword from the stone, peace will be brought to the land once more!



Note: Covers the Calibur Arc from a side story in Volume 8 of the light novel series.



(Source: Yen Press)

2095458.synopsis:
Novel of the second Gintama movie, written by Oosaki Tomohito, the same author of Ginpachi-sensei.
What would have happened if the Shiroyasha never existed?
Edo is thrown to chaos by a mysterious cause. Sakata Gintoki, now lives in a world where the future has changed, without him. What has happened to the Yorozuya?
Gintoki, who is now a ghost of the past, must once again carry the burden in order to save his friends. He must finish the biggest job ever, which may be the final job of Yorozuya.
associated_names: Gekijouban Gintama: Kanketsu-hen - Yorozuya yo Eien Nare

2098786.synopsis:
The story centers on a fairly ordinary high school boy named Keita Amano. His hobby is video games, but apart from that, he has no conspicuous traits, and has never been in love. As Keita continues his gaming life, he suddenly becomes involved with the most beautiful girl at school, Tendou Karen, the president of the school's video game club. She shocks Keita when she suddenly asks him to join the video game club.



Watch how their relationship evolves and becomes more complicated, especially when other gamers come into the picture, creating all sorts of misunderstandings and drama.

2107234.synopsis:
It was love-at-first-sight when Nakamura met his classmate, Hirose. The two became friends after the shy and awkward Nakamura finally worked up the nerve to speak to him, but being buddy-buddy with your crush is a whole new kind of torture! And as he watches some other guy cuddle up with Hirose like casual bros, Nakamura tries to keep his head from exploding. Why can’t that be him?! Enjoy the hilarious new misadventures of Nakamura desperately trying to keep it together and not scare Hirose off. Hang in there, Nakamura!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

2120034.synopsis:
"You... are going to die tomorrow."



Satsuki Minazuki, 16 years old. Apart from being antisocial and declaring the death of her classmates, she is a normal second-year high school student. Her nickname is "Liar Satsuki." However, her eyes alone are abnormal. What she is gazing at is...



(Source: Shogakukan, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.
associated_names: Usotsuki Satsuki wa Shi ga Mieru

2129506.synopsis: "Magic." A sacred mystery usable only by those chosen. One day, a child from the slums named Arus finds he has the power to use magic. A sorcerer by the name of Genos Willzard learns of his talent and raises him, turning him into the greatest of assassins. One day, Genos gives him an order: To enroll at the Magic Academy...!?
associated_names: Ouritsu Mahou Gakuen no Saikasei: Hikongai Agari no Saikyou Mahoushi, Kizoku Darake no Gakuen de Musou Suru

2138978.synopsis:
Tenkuu no Torawarebito is a compilation booklet given to moviegoers in Japan that contains concept designs and three side stories related to the movie of the same name.



Includes:

1) Awakening of the Black Dream (Kuroki Yume no Mesame / 黒き夢の目醒め)

2) Looking for an Illusion (Maboroshi wo Motomete / 幻を求めて)

3) Galand's Warning (Galand no Chuukoku / ガランの忠告)
associated_names: Nanatsu no Taizai: Tenkuu no Torawarebito

2144866.synopsis:
Rakugo--the ultimate form of storytelling, where everything in a story is expressed with just your body and words. Shinta and his daughter Akane have been seduced by this wonderful form of classical entertainment. Having observed her father strive to pass the shin'uchi rakugo test, Akane will take her own steps into this unique world!



(Source: MANGA Plus)



Notes:

- Ranked 3rd in the 8th Next Manga Awards print manga category in 2022.

- Ranked 4th in the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2023 guidebook for male readers.

- Ranked 3rd in the Nationwide Bookstore Employees' Recommended Comics of 2023.

- Ranked 2nd in the 16th Manga Taisho in 2023.

- Nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Award in the shounen category in 2023.

- Included in the New York Public Library's 2023 Best Books for Teens.

- Included in YALSA's 2024 Great Graphic Novels for Teens.

2155618.synopsis:
Mikhail Walpurgis didn't feel qualified for the title of Hero, and instead let the warrior Siegfried lead the prophesied battle against the Devil. But after Siegfried dies and the army is defeated, Mikhail has one last move before the end of the world. And so he turns back time. Now, Mikhail has the chance to reclaim the title he gave up and save everyone. The only problem is, no one believes the prophecy about the war! Can Mikhail manage to gather an army and make this life count?



(Source: Tapas)

2188386.synopsis: One of the five possible miniature books (mamehon) given as gifts for mailing in entry tickets found in Harta volume 70 or certain Harta series tankobon.

3021410.synopsis:
The Katvarna Empire is at war with the neighboring Republic of Kioka. In the Katvarna Empire, the lazy, woman-admiring Ikuta hates war, but due to certain circumstances, he grudgingly takes the High Grade Military Officer Exam. No one would have expected that this 17-year-old young man would eventually become a soldier called a great commander by others. Ikuta survives this world engulfed in war with his superior intellect.



(Source: Anime News Network)
associated_names: Nejimaki Seirei Senki: Tenkyou no Alderamin

3112802.synopsis:
Being an adult is hard. For 31-year-old Uramichi Omota, that depressing truth weighs on him. While on TV, he’s an upbeat exercise instructor for a children’s show, but sometimes he can’t keep his sardonic comments to himself. Even his coworkers, a pair of mascots and a singing duo, keep revealing the plight of adulthood on air. Regardless, they’re working through it one a day at a time.

(Source: Funimation)

3151970.synopsis:
"When was the last time I played a game that wasn't crap?" This is a world in the near future where games that use display screens are classified as retro. Anything that can't keep up with state-of-the-art VR technology is called a "crap game," and you see a large number of crap games coming out. Those who devote their lives to clearing these games are called "crap-game hunters," and Rakuro Hizutome is one of them. The game he's chosen to tackle next is Shangri-La Frontier, a "god-tier game" that has a total of thirty million players. Online friends... An expansive world... Encounters with rivals... These are changing Rakuro and all the other players' fates! The best game adventure tale by the strongest "crap game" player begins now!



(Source: Crunchyroll)
